answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the pigment of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the mesa of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lantern re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
